name: cognee-cursor-status
description: Shows the Cognee memory plugin's status in Cursor's status bar (connection, dataset, mode, memory hits) and switches the chat's dataset on click.

cognee.pluginRoot.description: Folder of the Cognee Cursor plugin (the one holding scripts/). Empty: the newest installed copy under ~/.cursor/plugins.

cognee.python.description: Python interpreter for the plugin's scripts. Empty: python3 (python on Windows).
